description.blurb: S/2019 S 14 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Inuit group. It was discovered in 2019 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2019 S 14 is about 4 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 17.9 million km in 893.14 days. It has an inclination of 46.2° to the ecliptic in a prograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.172.
